title: System Design - Part 3
description: System design covering requirements analysis, architecture patterns, scalability, availability, load balancing, caching, databases, Redis, queues, microservices, and API gateways. This submodule covers: Microservices, API Gateway, Authentication, Logging, Monitoring.
learning_outcomes: Analyze system requirements and define architecture
Design scalable and highly available systems
Implement load balancing and caching strategies
